column4: a tall goblin-built finish gate over a wide race road: two riveted scrap-metal pillars with brass bands, joined at the top by a long plain black and white checkered banner, wide open empty space underneath for racers to pass, no text, no letters, no signs

a tall goblin-built starting gate over a wide race road: two wooden towers with brass lanterns, joined at the top by a plain red cloth banner, wide open empty space underneath for racers to pass, no doors, no text, no letters, no signs
